topic: Parking sensors beeping like something's there — when nothing is? Here's the first thing to check.

beats.vo: Parking sensors beeping like something's there — when nothing is?
beats.visual: Macro shot of a rear bumper corner, focus racking onto a small round parking-sensor disc embedded in the bumper skin, static camera, overcast daylight

beats.vo: Usually it's dirt, ice, or road salt covering a sensor, not a wiring fault.
beats.visual: Interior close-up on a dashboard/infotainment cluster's parking-assist icon illuminated, static mounted camera, dim ambient cabin light

beats.vo: Wipe down each sensor on the bumper — the small round discs, not the badge or the camera — with a soft cloth.
beats.visual: Cut sequence of two contrasting macro shots: one sensor disc caked with road-salt haze/grime, one clean sensor disc, consistent studio-style lighting, static/locked camera on each

beats.vo: Still beeping after a clean bumper? May indicate a sensor or wiring issue, not just buildup.
beats.visual: Close-up of a handheld diagnostic scanner plugged into an OBD port beneath a dash, screen glow soft-focus, static camera, no hand in frame

beats.vo: Worth checking if it doesn't clear. Stop by and we'll take a look.
